Title: K-Means IP has increasing objective, but better performance - logging issue? 
Description: # Summary

When running k-means with `spherical=True`, final classification results are improved compared to using an L2 distance metric when the features are unit normed. This is expected. 

However, when inspecting training loss with with `.obj` attribute, the loss increases with each iteration. I'm not sure what's causing this discrepancy. As I'm using k-means++ by initializing the centroids manually with `nredo=1` and selecting the best of multiple runs, the `.obj` attribute needs to be accurate to select the lowest loss model.
